house.title: Olivier and Cindy Bréelle, charcutiers and caterers in Henriville

items.q: How far ahead should I order?
items.a: For click & collect, 24 hours is enough: choose the day and time in the form. For a buffet or a group meal, allow at least a week, more during the holidays.

items.q: How can I find out about allergens?
items.a: Everything is made on site, so we know every recipe. Ask us at the counter or by phone and we will tell you which allergens are present (gluten, milk, egg, mustard, celery…).

items.q: How should I store charcuterie and ready meals?
items.a: In the fridge, between 0 and 4 °C. Sliced charcuterie and salads are best eaten within two to three days; ready meals reheat in the oven or microwave. If in doubt, ask us at the counter.
You pay in store when you collect. There is no online payment. For buffets and large orders, a deposit may be requested.
Orders are collected from the shop. For catering, tell us about your venue in the quote request and we will let you know what is possible.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
items.a: Yes, call us on +33 3 22 45 11 18 as early as possible, at the latest the day before collection.

cateringPage.title: Caterer in Amiens: buffets and platters
cateringPage.lead: From their charcuterie in Henriville, Olivier and Cindy Bréelle cater buffets, receptions and family meals across Amiens. The same homemade food as in the shop, scaled to your event.

steps.x: Date, number of guests, budget: fill in the form or give us a call.
We send you a menu and a price, and adjust it with you if needed.
You collect everything from the shop, ready to serve, at the agreed time.

faq.q: How long before the event should I book?
faq.a: Ideally two to three weeks, at least one week. Around Christmas and New Year, book as early as you can.

faq.q: Can you adapt the menu (no pork, vegetarian, allergies)?
faq.a: Mention it in your request: we adapt the proposal as far as possible and tell you the allergens in each dish.
Platters come ready to serve. For anything else (plates, tablecloths, service), tell us what you need in your request.
For larger events, a deposit may be requested on confirmation. The balance is paid in store.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.editorText: Maison Bréelle – Charcuterie Traiteur, 11 rue Gaulthier de Rumilly, 80000 Amiens, France. Phone: +33 3 22 45 11 18.
legal.dataText: Information entered in the order and quote forms is used only to handle your request. It is emailed to the shop and is neither stored on the site nor passed on to third parties. You can ask for it to be deleted by calling the shop.
legal.cookiesText: This site uses no advertising cookies and no audience measurement. Only your language choice is remembered. The access map is provided by Google Maps.
